title: BOLD Infrastructure for Alzheimer's Reauthorization Act of 2024
official_summary:
BOLD Infrastructure for Alzheimer's Reauthorization Act of 2024

This act reauthorizes through FY2029 several programs that are administered by the Department of Health and Human Services to support research and resources related to Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

Specifically, the act reauthorizes (1) cooperative agreements with state, local, and tribal health departments to address Alzheimer's disease and related dementias through education, early detection, caregiver support, and other avenues; (2) regional centers that raise awareness and support research regarding these conditions; and (3) data collection on the incidence and prevalence of these conditions.

summary.headline: Law extends federal Alzheimer's and dementia public health programs through 2029.
summary.what_it_does: This law renews several Department of Health and Human Services programs focused on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias through fiscal year 2029. It continues agreements with state, local, and tribal health departments for education, early detection, and caregiver support. It also continues regional centers that raise awareness and support research, and keeps up data collection on how many people have these conditions.

who_it_affects.group: State, local, and tribal health departments
who_it_affects.how: They can keep working with the federal government under cooperative agreements on dementia education, early detection, and caregiver support.

who_it_affects.group: People living with Alzheimer's disease or other dementias
who_it_affects.how: Programs aimed at early detection and public health support for these conditions are continued.

who_it_affects.group: Family members and other caregivers of people with dementia
who_it_affects.how: Caregiver support efforts run through health departments are continued.

who_it_affects.group: Dementia researchers and public health experts
who_it_affects.how: Regional centers that support research and national data collection on these conditions are continued.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 11, 2024; programs are reauthorized through fiscal year 2029.
